utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll start with folks who’ve mentioned broken stuff lately, then check in with the usual helpers on the block. Who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Maybe start with Rey and the people who asked about repairs first. I can still swing by Saturday and bring those tools and a donation.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll reach out to Rey and the folks who asked first, and your Saturday tool run will help a lot. Thanks for pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late afternoon works best for me too. If you can send the exact time and meeting spot, I’ll coordinate pickup around school.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll send the exact time and meeting spot now. Do you want me to include the pickup details too?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please include the pickup details too — that’ll help me coordinate around school. Thanks!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’d like to double-check the drop-off location, the repair hours, and whether they need any specific parts or tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can check the drop-off spot and hours for you, and I’ll ask whether they need any specific parts or tools. If it helps, I can bring my drill too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Gus—please let me know the drop-off spot and hours once you’ve checked, and tell me if they need any specific parts or tools. Your drill might be useful too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Late afternoon still seems best to me—around 4:30, if that works. I just need the exact meet-up spot and what tools to bring so I can plan properly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: 4:30 works for me — let’s meet by the community shed. Please bring the hammer, screwdrivers, tape measure, and any cordless drill you have.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, that works for me. I’ll bring the hammer, screwdrivers, tape measure, and my cordless drill, and I’ll meet you by the community shed at 4:30.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Vik, the repair drive is coming together nicely—want me to put you on the invite list and spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, put me on the invite list — I’ll pass the repair drive plan along to the neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Vik — I’ve got you on the list, and I really appreciate you spreading the word too. This should help the repair drive go smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m pretty sure I promised a few supplies, though I may need to check my note and make sure I bring the right ones.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No worries, Oren — check your note when you can, and I’ll keep folks posted so everything stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — I’ll check my note and make sure I bring what I promised. Appreciate you keeping everyone organized.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Ira—thanks. If you hear anything, just let me know and I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’m heading out now, so I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good—let’s make the list first, then pick a meeting time and divide the errands.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — let’s make the list first, then choose a meeting time and split up the errands. I can help sort the donated tools and match them to the repair lists.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a good start, Mara. Let’s sort the tools first, then we can set the meeting time and hand out the errands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll double-check the drop-off location, the repair hours, and whether they need any specific parts or tools before I pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana — that’d help a lot. If you hear back, just let me know what’s still needed and I can come by to sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the drop-off location, repair hours, and whether they need any parts or tools, then let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on for this weekend, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still on for this weekend. We just need to keep gathering the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, thanks — I just wanted to make sure it’s really still happening.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I haven’t sorted mine yet, but I’m still planning to bring something by. If you need help, I can do the pickup run after school—just send me the details and I’ll keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — I’d appreciate the pickup run after school. I’m still getting the tools and repair list together, so send me the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, send them over when you’ve got them and I’ll handle it after school, quietly.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m getting the repair drive organized now and will make sure folks know where to bring things. If you want anything specific on the flyer, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve mostly just heard bits and pieces, so if you can share the time, meeting spot, and any tools to bring, I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll add the time, meeting spot, and a note to bring any small tools if they have them. I’ll get that to you right away so you can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — please confirm the drop-off location, repair hours, and whether any specific parts or tools are needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check the drop-off location and repair hours, and I’ll also see what parts or tools are needed. I’ll get back to you with the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’ll wait for the details and keep the repair drive notes updated.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’m pretty sure it’s this Saturday at the community hall. I can swing by for a bit and bring a few tools and a donation.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I can help sort the donated tools and match them to the repair lists. Point me to what’s already been collected.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks — I might’ve missed the collection list, but I’ll point you to it if I find it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira — please let me know the exact time and where we’re meeting once you hear back, so I can plan for it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and get you the exact time and meeting spot as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I’m glad to help however I can with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Sam — I’ll put your name on the invite list and spread the word. It’s going to be a big help having you there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Glad to help, Quinn — just let me know if there’s anything else I should do for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It really is shaping up nicely — everyone’s been so generous with tools and supplies. I’ll keep passing the word along if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to hear it, Tess — I can bring my drill and toolkit Saturday if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely, Gus — your drill and toolkit would be a huge help on Saturday. I’ll pass that along and keep the neighbors posted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Vik — I’m still waiting on any updates about the repair drive. If you hear anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and pass any repair drive updates along to the neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Vik — appreciate it. Just let me know if anything comes up about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do the pickup run after school. Just let me know the details, and I’ll keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s really kind of you, Uli. I’m still trying to remember exactly what I promised, but I’ll sort it out and let you know what to pick up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No rush — just send me the details when you’ve got them, and I’ll take care of it quietly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can check tools and spare parts first. What’s currently needed?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Mostly hand tools and whatever spare parts you think are likely to fit. If you spot anything specific we’re short on, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll check for common hand tools and likely-fit spare parts, then send you a short list of anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, that helps—so it’s small fixes on Saturday, and Gus can lend a drill if needed? I’d still love the exact time and meeting spot when you know them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, small fixes this Saturday by the community hall, and Gus can bring the drill if we need it. I’ll send the exact time and meeting spot as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks — I’ll wait for the exact time and meeting spot, and please let me know if there’s anything else I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll double-check the drop-off location, the repair hours, and whether they need any specific parts or tools before I pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Hana — that sounds good. Please let me know the time and place once you’ve checked those details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll check the time and place and send you the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it’s still happening. We’re meeting at 10, and I’ll point you to the tools and repair lists when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so it’s definitely still on for 10, then? Just wanted to make sure I’ve got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — definitely still on for 10. I’ll be there to help point you to the tools and repair lists.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good, Cleo — I’ll keep things organized and help spread the word. Let me know what you want on the flyer, and I’ll make sure it’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — please put the date, time, and that we need tools, gloves, trash bags, and a few volunteers. I’ll bring the supplies list and have everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll put the date, time, and supply needs on the flyer and make sure folks know we still need a few volunteers. Thanks, Cleo; I’ll help keep everything moving smoothly.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
